This represents payment for fees earned during the month of December in the current year, decreasing Accounts Receivable by $150; and payment for revenues earned during January and February of the subsequent year, increasing Fee Revenue by $300. For ease of presentation, this assumes DataForce makes adjusting entries at the end of each year, not monthly. Transaction: Receipt of quarterly payment from client in the subsequent year.
